description: v4 only. Aave v4 protocol-wide history: market size, total borrows and available liquidity per sample over a window. Omit chainId to cover every supported v4 chain. Use this for 'is the protocol growing', not for one wallet (get_user_summary_history) or one reserve (get_apy_history).

chainId.description: Chain id to restrict to, e.g. 1 for Ethereum. Omit the argument entirely to cover every chain.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_protocol_history
title: Protocol totals over time (v4)
